text: Escalate to the sales director when ANY of these are true: (1) a food-safety issue — mold, pests, contamination, or a cold-chain break; (2) churn risk on an account worth more than $50,000 per year; (3) the contact has made 3 or more contacts about the same issue without resolution; (4) a legal, press, or health-authority threat. When in doubt on a high-value account, escalate rather than guess.
